verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that sevDesk does double-entry bookkeeping with a chart of accounts and lets users view journal entries in the trial balance. It never documents posting manual journal entries, entering balanced debit and credit lines, or attaching memos. Viewing system-generated journal entries is an adjacent capability and does not show manual entry posting.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can post manual journal entries with balanced debits, credits, and supporting memos
